extraction_warnings: Detailed per-participant clinical characteristics (age, BMI, etc.) are referenced to Supplementary Tables 1 and 2, which were not included in the provided text; therefore numeric age/BMI values for the main 147-person cohort could not be extracted.

Specific individual-level age and BMI data are available only for the 6 human donors (3 AN, 3 HC) used in the mouse FMT experiment; these were not converted into sample-level rows because they lack explicit subject/sample IDs and represent a small non-representative subset of the full sequenced cohort.

DNA extraction kit information differs by sample type: main human shotgun metagenomics used an unspecified protocol (IHMS SOP P7 V2), while mouse/donor 16S sequencing used the NucleoSpin soil mini kit (MACHEREY-NAGEL).
Sequencing platform also differs by sub-experiment: Ion Proton for main human shotgun metagenomics vs Illumina MiSeq for 16S rRNA sequencing in the mouse FMT experiment.

AN subtype information (AN-RS n=56, AN-BP n=21) exists but was not used as primary subgroup stratification here; only AN vs HC was used as subgroups per the dominant case-control framework of the study.
No PMID or canonical study_name identifier was found within the provided text.
Batch 1 returned granularity='sample_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 1 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['AN', 'HC']; kept batch 0.

Full cohort (77 AN, 70 HC) clinical/demographic characteristics are located in Supplementary Table 1 and 2, which were not included in the provided text; most study-level clinical fields (age, BMI, smoking, etc.) could not be extracted at aggregate level and are marked not_reported.

Sample-level data were only explicitly available for the 6 human FMT donors (3 AN-RS cases, 3 HC) described in the Methods (Animal experiments) and Results sections; these were used to populate the 'samples' array. This is a small, non-random subset of the full cohort chosen for the mouse FMT experiment.
Disease values for samples were kept as verbatim abbreviations used in the paper ('AN', 'HC', 'AN-RS') per extraction rules; downstream harmonization should map these to standard terms.
AN-RS subtype specification for donors is explicit ('three randomly chosen AN-RS cases'); HC donors have no reported subtype equivalent, hence disease_details marked not_reported for them.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['AN', 'HC']; kept batch 0.

Schema fields (biomarker_name/value/unit, OS, ECOG, tumor size, feces_phenotype_value) are largely oncology/clinical-trial oriented and do not map well to this microbiome/eating-disorder study; most were marked not_reported.

The study includes both human participants and germ-free mice; host_species field only allows a single value, so human was chosen as primary but mouse experiments are extensively described and should be reviewed if multi-species extraction is needed.

Detailed quantitative biomarker values (e.g., glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR, CRP) are referenced only qualitatively in the main text; exact numbers reside in Supplementary Tables 1-2, which were not included in the provided text.
